# **🚀 Project Documentation — SupportAI**

## **🧩 Project Overview**

**SupportAI** is a simple full-stack web application that provides an AI-powered customer support assistant. Users can ask questions related to products, services, policies, and common issues.

The application uses a company knowledge base to provide relevant AI responses and allows users to raise support tickets for unresolved issues.

### **The app includes:**

* Customer-facing interface for AI support.  
* User authentication and dashboard.  
* AI-powered chat using an LLM.  
* Knowledge-base-based responses.  
* Conversation history.  
* Support ticket creation and tracking.

---

## **⚙️ Tech Stack**

| Component | Technology Used |
| ----- | ----- |
| Frontend | React.js, CSS / Tailwind CSS |
| Backend | Node.js, Express.js |
| Database | PostgreSQL / Supabase |
| Authentication | JWT |
| AI | LLM API, RAG |
| API Communication | REST API, Axios |
| Testing | Postman |
| Version Control | Git, GitHub  |

---

## **🎯 Key Features**

✅ **User Authentication:** Secure signup and login for customers.

✅ **AI Customer Support:** Users can ask questions and receive AI-generated responses.

✅ **Knowledge Base:** AI uses company FAQs and documentation to provide relevant answers.

✅ **Conversation History:** Users can view their previous AI conversations.

✅ **Support Tickets:** Users can raise tickets when their issue cannot be resolved by the AI.

✅ **Ticket Tracking:** Users can view the status of their submitted tickets.

---

## **🧪 Testing**

The backend REST APIs can be tested using Postman.

Testing includes:

* Authentication  
* AI chat API  
* Conversation APIs  
* Ticket APIs  
* Input validation  
* Unauthorized requests

Frontend  → Vercel  
Backend   → Render  
Database  → Supabase

**SupportAI** combines **full-stack web development and artificial intelligence** to provide an interactive customer support platform.
